snippet.title: BuluMonster Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Bulu Monster - a monster collecting game in iOS 
==Download our game now! http://sigma-game.com/buluios == 

Bulu Monster is a RPG adventure game with over 150 type of monsters. You are a talented monster trainer in Bulu island. You have to discover, fight, capture and train your monster as your profession. You can also challenge your friend and other trainers online!
